name: toolstrek
description: A modern collection of free online tools designed to boost productivity for developers and everyday users.

paragraphs: A high-performance, privacy-focused online utility hub built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4.
Featuring 110 powerful tools across developer, text, PDF, image, chart, QR, calculator, finance, health, productivity, and security workflows — 100% free with no registration required.
features: ⚡ Browser-First Architecture — The large majority of tools run 100% client-side using WebAssembly, the WebCodecs API, and plain JavaScript. No uploads, no round-trips, no server latency.
🔒 Zero Data Storage & Privacy — Files, passwords, documents, and inputs are processed in volatile browser memory and never leave your device for client-side tools.
🎨 Modern Design System — Sleek dark/light theme, polished typography, and smooth micro-animations powered by Framer Motion / motion.
🔍 Command Palette Search — Keyboard-accessible global search (Cmd + K / Ctrl + K) to launch any tool in milliseconds.
⭐ Favorites System — Pin frequently used tools to a dedicated Favorites dashboard, persisted via SSR-safe localStorage.
